data.name: Masd
data.gender_notes: Masd is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ma'dah' meaning knowledge, wisdom, a place of knowledge, or a learned man. This name is a powerful reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in one's life and spiritual journey. The name Masd carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Masd usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, and the understanding that these qualities are essential for personal growth and spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Masd belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masd total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مَصد
in_arabic.meaning: الجديد المكتشف في القرآن، أو الذي يُصَدّ، ويُشير إلى الشخص الذي يُكتشف فيه الجود
in_arabic.long_meaning: المَصد هو اسم علم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، ويُشتق من الجذر (صَدَ) الذي يعني اكتشاف شيء جيد، أو اكتشاف شخص جودي. في الإسلام، يُعتبر المَصد اسمًا مشروعًا لطفل ذكر أو أنثى، ويستند على الآية القرآنية (وَلا تُؤَمِّلَنَّ مَصَدًّا أَن تُفَتَّحَ لَكَ مَسأَلَةً تَنتَظِرُ نِصابَهَا، وَلَكِنِ الَّذينَ يَتَوَكَّلونَ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ وَيَتَوَزَّعونَ بَيْنَ الصَدَقَةِ وَالصَّوْمِ، وَمَن يُوقِ شَغَفَهُ عَنكَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَميدٌ).

in_urdu.name: مَصد
in_urdu.meaning: قرآن میں پہلی بار ظاہر ہونے والا، یا جس کے پاس جود ہے، اور جو کچھ اچھا ہے وہ اس کی جانب کی جانب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مَصد ایک خاندانی نام ہے جو عرب زبانمیں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اس کا ماخذ الجذر (صَدَ) سے ہے جس کا مطلب اچھی چیز کا پتہ لگانا ہے، یا اچھے شخص کا پتہ لگانا۔ اس اسلامی روایات میں، مَصد ایک مشروع نام ہے جو پیدائش کے وقت طفل کو دیا جاتا ہے، اور اس کی بنیاد کورئان کی آیت پر ہے (اور جنت کی امید کیوں نہیں رکھو، کہ تمہیں ایک سوال کا جواب دیا جائے گا جسے تم منتظیر ہو، لیکن جو لوگ اپنے رب پر بھروسہ کرتے ہیں اور صدقہ اور روزہ تقسیم کرتے ہیں، اور جو شخص تم سے محبت کرتا ہے تو اللہ غنی ہے ہمیشہ کے لیے حمید ہے

in_hindi.name: मसद
in_hindi.meaning: कुरआन में पहली बार दिखाई देने वाला या जिसके पास अच्छाई है, जिसके पास खुशी है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मसद एक हिंदू और इस्लामी नाम है, जो अरबी भाषा से आया है, इसका अर्थ है अच्छाई का पता लगाना, या अच्छे व्यक्ति का पता लगाना। इस्लामिक परंपराओं में, मसद एक स्वीकार्य नाम है जो जन्म के समय बच्चे को दिया जाता है, इसकी आधारशिला कुरआन की आयत पर है (और गंतव्य हिल की उम्मीद न रखो, कि तुम्हें एक प्रश्न का उत्तर दिया जाएगा जिसे तुम प्रतीक्षा कर रहे हो, लेकिन जो लोग अपने प्रभु पर भरोसा करते हैं और सहायता और उपवास को बांटते हैं, और जो व्यक्ति तुम से प्यार करता है, तो अल्लाह अमीर ہے اور آبد ہے

in_pashto.name: مسډ

in_english.name: Masd
in_english.meaning: First appearance in the Quran, or the owner of a good thing, or the one who discovers a good thing, or a good person
in_english.long_meaning: Masd is an Arabic name that means discovering a good thing, or discovering a good person. In Islamic tradition, Masd is a name given to children at birth, based on the Quranic verse (and do not expect to be given a question to which you will not be given an answer, but those who put their trust in their Lord and distribute the alms and fast, and who is pleased with you, Allah is rich and is praised)

data.cultural_impact: The name Masd carries a deep cultural significance in Islamic history and tradition. Masd is often associated with scholars, prestigious educational institutions, and centers of learning. In many Islamic communities, the title 'Masdee' or 'Honored Master of Knowledge' is given to scholars and teachers who have dedicated their lives to the pursuit and dissemination of knowledge. The name Masd also evokes the image of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companions who were known as 'Sahabah' or 'Companions of the Prophet', who were not only soldiers and leaders but also scholars and teachers who spread the message of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Masd is a constant reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in one's path to Allah. Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "The seeking of knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim." (Bukhari and Muslim). Masd encourages individuals to strive for knowledge and wisdom, not only to enrich their lives but also to serve their communities and help bring about positive change in the world. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) also said, "Seek knowledge, even if it is in China." This implies that knowledge and wisdom have no boundaries and that individuals should go to great lengths to seek them out. By embracing the name Masd, individuals are reminded to prioritize their pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, not just for their personal growth, but also as a means to serve and please Allah.
